Why go: one boat for a big group

Finding one boat for 20, 30 or 40 people is hard on Koh Samui; most private speedboats top out around 10 to 15. Orange is a new, large speedboat licensed for up to 45 guests, with booth seating so the group sits together and a swim deck at the back for getting in and out of the water. The price covers 10 guests, and each extra person adds a small per-head charge, which makes it good value for big parties.

Three full-day routes are offered: the beaches of Koh Phangan, the islands of Ang Thong Marine Park, or Koh Tao and the Koh Nang Yuan sandbar.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: weddings, company outings, family reunions and groups of friends over about 15.
  • Choose something else if you are a group of 10 or fewer: the Sao speedboat or other private boats cost less for a small group.
  • Planning a celebration? See our wedding guide for venues and logistics.

Good to know

  • Ang Thong: closed from 1 November to 15 December each year.
  • Fees and lunch: park fees are cash only, and pre-ordering lunch avoids a long wait at a beach restaurant with a big group.
  • Weather: the captain decides whether a route is safe. From October to December the north-east monsoon makes the open-water routes rough.
  • Alcohol: drink moderately on a speedboat; swimming after drinking is how most boat-trip accidents happen.

Planning for a big group

Send us your guest list, ages and pickup addresses early: with 30 or more people, transfers, lunch orders and life-jacket sizes need planning. Share one WhatsApp group with the organiser so the captain can confirm times and the meeting point. Ask everyone to bring cash for the park fees, as collecting money on the beach slows the day down.
